_comment: Single source of truth for repository settings that a template cannot copy.
COMPARES live settings against it and fails on drift.
Edit here first, then re-run scripts/bootstrap.sh.

ruleset.name: main-protection
_strict_options_comment: Both default to false. Flip to true and re-run scripts/bootstrap.sh to enforce.
strict_required_status_checks_policy: require branches to be up to date
with main before merging (costs a rebase/merge per stale PR).
required_signatures: require signed commits (needs GPG/SSH signing
configured on every machine you commit from, including CI bots).
